high_level_description: An iPhone photo of a ginger tabby cat wearing a tiny purple wizard hat, sitting on an old oak desk and reading an open red leather-bound spellbook by candlelight in a small stone-walled study.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Interior of a small study with rough grey stone walls and a dark timber beam ceiling. A narrow arched window on the left shows an overcast evening sky. The scene is lit by the amber pool from a beeswax candle on the desk mixed with cool-neutral daylight from the window, neutral white balance. Dark wooden plank floor below the desk.

elements.desc: Dark oak writing desk with a scuffed, worn top and visible wood grain, spanning the lower third of the frame beneath the cat and the book.
Stack of three old hardcover books with faded green, blue and brown cloth covers, piled at the back left corner of the desk, spines facing the viewer.
Gold embossed capital letters running along the spine of the top book in the stack, serif, bold, upright, small.

Ginger tabby cat with orange striped fur, a white chest and white front paws, and green eyes, sitting upright on the desk with its gaze lowered onto the open book and its right front paw resting on the left page. A tiny dark purple felt wizard hat with a pointed tip and small gold star appliqués sits tilted between its ears.

Large open spellbook bound in deep crimson red leather with gold-tooled borders and brass corner caps, lying flat on the desk in front of the cat. Yellowed parchment pages covered in handwritten black ink script, with a small inked diagram of a circle ringed by runes on the right page.
Handwritten heading at the top of the right page of the open spellbook, black ink, script, regular, upright, small.
Half-melted beeswax pillar candle with wax drips down its side, standing in a small round brass holder on the right side of the desk, its flame lit.
White goose feather quill pen standing in a small round glass inkwell filled with black ink, placed on the desk to the right of the spellbook and in front of the candle.
